description: NaSbP₂S₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.41 Å. Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Sb-S bond distances ranging from 2.56-3.02 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one P and three S atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.26 Å. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.09 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one P and three S atoms. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.08 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Sb and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Sb and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
